commit.message:
feat(wire): post convex Agie punches with checked corner clearance

Keep the complete nominal polygon and bound the swept wire for both round and mitered joins. Check perpendicular entry room along an oblique face. Add an original pentagonal punch example.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2953

fix(wire): bound oblique Agie entry rounding on the ISO grid

Check both sides of the emitted seam against the drilled hole, separation allowance, retained punch and stock envelope. Preserve the nominal polygon and fixed start-hole position.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2953

feat(post): support measured Agie QN2 stock heights

Use the measured maximum wire-centre offset for each supported plate thickness. Check the swept wire and acute corner miters before publishing the native bundle.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2954

feat(post): support checked reentrant Agie punch contours

Prove that the cap unions and each finite wall form one vertical extrusion. Check rough compensation at inside corners and clearance between unrelated faces. Keep the nominal polygon and exterior entry in the native job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2956

feat(post): export a selected Agie through die opening

Match the selected edge chains to the complete vertical through-opening. Check the interior threading lead, rough joins and nominal wall clearance before emitting the closed die cycle.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2957

feat(post): emit Agie straight cutoffs with separate air endpoints

Check the retained wall, kerf side, air approaches and centered XY travel. Require the operator to clamp both pieces through all QN2 passes. Keep closed work on its existing nominal cycle.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2962

feat(post): group two captured Agie punches on one piece

Validate each retained source, pierced lead and swept cut against its partner. Bind the two geometry resources and work points in one atomic native controller job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2961

test(post): exercise both native Agie cutoff compensation sides

Both source selections now travel in positive X. Pin the independent left and right native work types and the two start points on each job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2962
Merge branch 'issue/2962-agie-straight-cutoff' into issue/2961-agie-multiple-works

Merge main into issue/2953-agie-planar-punch: port the oblique punch onto the zero-step setup

Main rewrote the native writer for #2984 (zero-step PunchSetup20, the
1.0 mm separation rule) and renamed the user-visible texts for #3537.
Keep main's prepare() frame with its checked stock and start-hole setup.
Port this branch's convex envelope check, exterior seam search and
corner-clearance checks into it, in place of the rectangle refusal.
Refusal texts name the problem, not the machine. Port the tests to the
new prepare() signature and add an export test of the oblique punch
through the zero-step setup.

Refs #2953

Merge the ported #2955 into issue/2954-agie-stock-heights

Port the measured QN2 stock heights onto the zero-step setup of #2984.
The measured offset table moves into camcraft_post::agie_setup.
PunchSetup20 gets height_um and refuses an unmeasured thickness.
The height goes into ID_HEIGHT (piece and work) and ID_POSPOSZ. The
operator review names the thickness and its four offsets. A 20 mm job
stays byte-identical. The corner and face clearance use the measured
rough offset of the selected thickness.

Refs #2954

Merge the ported #2964 head into the reentrant punch branch

Port the reentrant punch checks onto the zero-step setup writer (#2984)
and the measured QN2 stock heights (#2964). Drop the convex refusal and
keep the setup, separation and stock checks of main. Move the feature
spacing check and the reentrant tests into their own files. Rename the
refusal texts to the native wire EDM job (#3537).

Merge #2968 (1962fd5dc) into the die opening port

Port the die opening of #2957 onto the zero-step setup (#2984), the
measured heights (#2964) and the reentrant checks (#2968). The retired
writer jescript.rs stays deleted. PunchSetup20::encode_die writes the
zero-step setup with ID_PUNCH,c_die and refuses every thickness but
20 mm. A die opening must be convex; it is reversed so the envelope,
reach and spacing checks offset toward the waste inside the opening.
The entry moves to agie/contour/entry.rs with the inside-hole and
other-wall clearance rules. The die test joins the agie_native binary
and compares the CLI SBL with the new DIE20.SBL golden.

Fixes #2957

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge #2969 port (30e6c4c3f) into the straight cutoff port

Move the open cut onto the zero-step setup writer of #2984. The new
agie_setup::CutoffSetup20 writes c_left or c_right, stp1 and stp2 in air,
no separation and ASDELETE only. export_with_review routes an open job to
cutoff::prepare. A closed cycle keeps the 1.0 mm separation rule.

Refs #2962

Merge #2972 (f99a9d736) into issue/2961-agie-multiple-works

Port the punch group onto the zero-step setup writer of #2984.
The old script writer (jescript.rs) is gone. The piece writer in
agie_setup/piece.rs now writes one quality, one group and a loop of
works CUT1..n. A new PunchGroup20 encodes two captured punches, each
with its own ISO stem and start hole. The post export
export_group_with_review keeps the single-work path and bytes.
